rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a drinking cup or the amount it contains.

example.english: I want a cup of hot tea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 jat1 bui1 jit6 caa4

rows.note: Use this for a sports trophy or the competition named after that trophy, as in 世界盃.

example.english: Tonight is the World Cup final.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 hai6 sai3 gaai3 bui1 kyut3 coi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for one of the breast-covering cups of a bra.

example.english: The cup of this bra doesn't fit me.
example.traditional: 呢件內衣嘅罩杯唔啱我。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 noi6 ji1 ge3 zaau3 bui1 m4 ngaam1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a suction cup that sticks to a smooth surface.

example.english: This suction cup won't stick firmly to the glass.
example.traditional: 呢個吸盤黐唔實塊玻璃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kap1 pun4 ci1 m4 sat6 faai3 bo1 lei1
